title: RBI issues Draft (Securitisation Transactions) Amendment Directions
description: In line with the objective to improve efficiency, liquidity and transparency in issuance and subsequent transfer of Securitisation Notes (SNs), RBI has today issued following draft Amendment Directions for public comments: a) Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Securitisation Transactions) Amendment Directions, 2026 b) Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks - Securitisation Transactions) Amendment Directions, 2026 c) Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies - Securitisati
